1.

Thou tender Father-heart That watchest over me, How shall I be able to love, How be able to praise Thee? Thou warnest me so faithfully Against all hidden snares, And hidest under Thy wing Thy timid, fearful child.

2.

Thou feedest and Thou clothest, And guardest me so well, And carest every day For both body and soul. I should soon be undone, If Thou didst not do so. O, could I but love, But love Thee still!

3.

Grant that with holy obedience I may ever give Thee right! Make Thy commandments dear to me, Thy burden sweet and light! And when a danger threatens, A need alarms me, Let me in the first place But ever flee to Thee!

4.

Thy Father-heart breaketh With compassion, Thou seest whatsoever I lack, Thou knowest all my woe. By night and by day Thine eye open standeth, And the Father-hand reacheth, As far as heaven extendeth.
